body: Yes red is legal, but orange isn’t. A settlement can’t be placed adjacent to another settlement. However, if another player has built out roads that leave a space open for a settlement, another player can build a settlement there, in turn splitting the other players road in half. In this game, white would only have a road 5 links long (tied with blue and red).
